title: Seat a root several workspaces declare as shared
summary: A path under a root several workspaces declare in composition.sources now resolves as shared (resolveSeat returns by: 'shared' with every declarer in declarers, and no seat) instead of seating at whichever declarer's identity sorts first. Mandate resolution reads every declarer's closure there and lets a mandate's authority.scope govern only when it names every declarer; ia position names the declarers; and ia preview and ia author accept an edit there when the repository's workspace is any declarer, so they no longer refuse it as IA-CLI-EDIT-UNOWNED.
